title: Doozy Vape Co Infinity Fizzy Lemon Lime 50/50 Shortfill E-Liquid 100ml
description: Fizzy Lemon Lime by Doozy Infinity captures the sharp tang of fresh citrus with a lively, effervescent twist. Bright Lemon offers a sweet-sharp citrus base, balanced by the vibrant juiciness of Lime for a layered flavour that zings across the tastebuds. A fizzy finish rounds it all off, giving this unique blend a sparkle that lingers delightfully between draws. Blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, this shortfill e-liquid is designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping with pod kits, vape pens, and compact starter devices. Each 120ml bottle contains 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid, with enough space to add two 10ml nic shots to suit your preferred strength. Doozy Infinity Podfills combine the satisfaction of balanced vapour and throat hit with the practicality of long-lasting 100ml bottles for everyday MTL use.
